queries_run: AppLovin tariff OR export control OR China trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司在中國有營運，美中緊張可能影響業務；美國對部分產品／技術輸往中國要求出口許可，但公司目前產品不受這些管制限制；中國政府曾對美國關稅與出口管制報復，可能間接影響公司。
findings.excerpt: Further, we have operations in China and the continuing tension between the U.S. and China may impact our business and results of operations in the future. The U.S. government has restricted the ability to send certain products and technology to China without an export license. In many cases, these licenses are subject to a policy of denial and will not be issued. While our current products are not restricted by these controls, such controls or future restrictions could impact our business in the future.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出關稅等總經因素可能影響廣告主支出或公司成本；廣告方案可能適用 EAR 出口管制，公司以 IP 封鎖與受制裁對象篩查因應。無實體硬體供應鏈關稅敘述。
findings.excerpt: Economic and political relations between the U.S. and other countries continue to evolve rapidly, including with respect to tariff and other policies, and changing policies may adversely affect our business by harming advertising spending or increasing our costs.

note: 搜尋僅 1 次，未找到具體關稅成本或實體清單事件；僅風險因素層級揭露。
